title: Strict-Transport-Security delivered over plaintext HTTP
description: The response carrying Strict-Transport-Security was fetched over http://. User agents ignore the header on a non-secure response, so the policy is not installed even though every configuration review sees an HSTS header. The site keeps its first-visit downgrade window while appearing to have closed it.
remediation: Serve HSTS only from the HTTPS listener, and make the HTTP listener answer with a redirect to HTTPS that does not pretend to set the policy. Check the proxy configuration for an add_header rule that is applied to both listeners.
limitation: One response and its scheme. The rule judges the secured-ness of the response that carried the header; it cannot see whether the HTTPS listener sets the header correctly.
